character.name: Create a finished pixel art
character.prompt: Create a finished pixel art sprite of a cute child-drawn astronaut, based on a simple handmade paper cutout with a playful, chunky silhouette. The astronaut should have an oversized rounded helmet, a bright yellow spacesuit, dark teal outline accents, a small chest control panel with orange details, and rounded limbs with slightly uneven handmade proportions. Keep the design charming, bold, and readable at small size, with a retro game sprite feel. Use a limited palette, clean edges, subtle shading, and strong contrast. Front-facing or slightly angled pose, isolated on a transparent background, no environment, no text, no extra props. Make it feel like a finished 16-bit style character sprite, friendly and whimsical, while preserving the spirit of a child’s original drawing.  Negative prompt: blurry, realistic, 3D render, detailed background, complex lighting, extra limbs, text, watermark, photorealistic, metallic armor, sci-fi realism, dark mood, noise, low contrast  Optional size note: 32x32 or 48x48 sprite, crisp pixel grid, game-ready. Create the base level character with a base level space suit, think about how a player can collect more gear to add on to their space suit
